title: Google Ads vs Meta Ads: Which Is Better for Your Kerala Business?
metaTitle: Google Ads vs Meta Ads: Which Is Better? | Helix24
metaDescription: Google Ads vs Meta Ads for Kerala businesses: how each works, which suits your industry, how to split a budget and when to use both.
excerpt: Google Ads and Meta Ads both bring customers, but in very different ways. Knowing the difference helps you put your budget where it will work hardest.
keyTakeaways: The key difference: searching vs scrolling
Which channel tends to suit which kinds of business
How to split a budget when you are starting
Why many businesses end up using both

sections.heading: Searching vs scrolling
paragraphs: Google Ads show up when someone searches for something, such as "dentist in Kakkanad" or "interior designer Calicut". These people already know what they want, so the enquiries tend to be ready to buy.

Meta Ads appear while people scroll Instagram and Facebook. They are not looking for you yet, so the ad has to catch their attention. Meta is good at creating demand and reaching people by location, age and interests.

sections.heading: Which suits your business
bulletPoints: Urgent or specific services (clinics, repairs, legal, B2B): Google Ads usually comes first, because people search when they need you.
Visual and lifestyle products (fashion, food, interiors, events): Meta Ads usually works better, because photos and video sell the product.
Real estate and education: often both, with Meta for reach and lead forms and Google for people searching specific projects or courses.
Local shops and restaurants: Meta for offers and awareness, plus a strong Google Business Profile.

sections.heading: Splitting a starting budget
paragraphs: If you are unsure, start with the channel that matches how your customers find you, and keep a smaller test budget on the other. After two or three months, move money towards whichever brings enquiries at a lower cost.

callout.title: Measure enquiries, not clicks
callout.text: Compare channels by cost per enquiry or cost per sale. A cheaper click is not better if it rarely turns into a customer.

sections.heading: Using both together
paragraphs: The two channels often support each other. People who see your Instagram ads may search for your name on Google later, and people who visit your site from Google can be reminded on Instagram. Once you know what works, running both usually gives the steadiest flow of leads.

faq.question: What does a click cost on Google Ads in Kerala?
faq.answer: It varies widely by industry and competition. Local services may pay a modest amount per click, while competitive areas such as real estate, finance and legal can cost much more. Google's Keyword Planner gives estimates for your own keywords.

faq.question: Can I run Google Ads without a website?
faq.answer: You can run call ads that ring your phone directly, but most campaigns work better with a fast, focused landing page that explains your offer.

faq.question: Which is cheaper, Google Ads or Meta Ads?
faq.answer: Meta clicks are often cheaper, but Google enquiries are often more ready to buy. The fair comparison is cost per customer, which you only learn by tracking both properly.
